title: Possible new serial number for Libre2
body:
I suppose new serial number for Libre2 (RU region) is released. Can't pair it with xdrip+ (3e86af7-2023.11.14) on Pixel 5.
OOP2 (8a0ee8f-2022.06.10) is installed also.

Libre2 (RU) was activated on another device (iPhone 13 Libre2 App). This device was disabled during pairing attepts with Pixel 5.

https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/10f2319be05be5a1f73ad87ff3a2b2c900272818/app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/models/LibreOOPAlgorithm.java#L304-L305
